surface: Nested column headers with rowspans and colspans: the arrows across and through the header levels, each header's name, and back to the cells.

expect: this is a very long header title
steps.note: Navigable headers: ArrowUp from A1 reaches the header over column A, `This is a very long header title`, which spans the two lower header levels. VoiceOver says no header role on a well-formed ARIA grid, as in grid-core: VoiceOver's behavior.
ArrowUp again reaches the group header over columns A to H, `Header title`.
ArrowRight from a group moves to the next group on its level, `I/J`, over columns I and J. NVDA reads the slash, VoiceOver drops it.
`I/J` spans two levels, so ArrowDown reaches the lowest header of column I, `I2`. NVDA spells it `I 2`.
ArrowLeft on the lowest level moves one column: `H2`.
ArrowDown leaves the headers for the first cell of column H, `H1`.
